english.title: Misrepresentation by employee etc of specified foreign power relating to unregistered relevant activity
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person who

(A)_[held office in or under]_
(B)_[was an employee or other member of staff]_

a foreign power specified by the Secretary of State in regulations **(..SPECIFY FOREIGN POWER..), carried out a relevant activity namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..), in the UK in that capacity, having made a misrepresentation about your activities or the capacity in which you acted when that activity was not registered with the Secretary of State by that person
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 68(3) and (10) and 80(1) of the National Security Act 2023.

english.notes:
(i) Sections 68(11) provides a defence to this offence, available to a person who has taken all steps reasonably practicable to determine whether the activities in question are or are not registered, and having taken such steps, reasonably believes that they are registered.
(ii) For the offence applying to specified persons carrying out specified activities without registration, see H101464 and for that applying to persons holding officer / members of staff of a specified person, see H101465.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and / or fine.
Indictment : maximum 5 years imprisonment and / or fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction depends on the general limit in a magistrates’ court and may be 6 or 12 months depending on the date of conviction, see section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.​​​​​​​

None
